headline: Binance Discloses Hack Involving Fake Job Interviews and $6.3 Billion Theft
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance revealed that hackers stole $6.3 billion using fake job interviews and a compromised internal AI tool. North Korea is reportedly suspected to be behind the heist.
why: Security breaches at major cryptocurrency exchanges impact platform liquidity, regulatory oversight, and investor confidence in digital asset markets.
